title.narrative: Assistance to enterprises in Fujian Province to meet greener product standards for mechanical and electrical equipment (Second Phase)

description.narrative: The project aims to achieve overall improvements through training and certification to enterprises. Implementation of environmental management systems, energy management systems as well as occupational health and safety standards will encourage enterprises to use new technology, material and energy and achieve green production. In addition, responding to the Central Committee#s call of promoting economic belts along Silk Road, exchanges and cooperation between green industries will be strengthened as well as innovative technology transfer between Fujian and countries along the Silk Road. The development objective is increased competitiveness of MEE manufactured in Fujian province in international markets through products that can meet green product and process standards.
